notes: A PAN-OS sysDescr often omits the version entirely; the profile still names the product so the device reports as UNASSESSED for advisories rather than clear. Platform-text detection for the `pan-os` profile (tracker 271) is DOC_CLAIMED, not device-confirmed: the markers are the PAN-OS tokens this document's vendor-level sysdescr_contains and device_type hints already carry, plus the "Palo Alto Networks PA-<model> series firewall" shape a PA firewall reports. The hyphen in "palo alto networks pa-" is load-bearing: bare "palo alto" would also capture "Palo Alto Networks Panorama", a management platform with a different command grammar and no profile of its own, and mis-routing it onto the firewall plan would be worse than not resolving it. `show system info` is the command PAN-OS documents for the version banner. Promote to live_capture when a real PA firewall reports.
